text: Setting project goals is essential for success. One effective method is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. These goals help teams stay focused and know exactly what they need to accomplish. It is also important to set milestones, which are key points in the project timeline that show progress. Deliverables are the final products or results that the project must produce. Finally, stakeholder alignment means making sure everyone involved, such as clients, managers, and team members, agrees on the goals. When all these elements work together, projects are more likely to finish on time and meet expectations.
